rule: A gate is closed only when its state is explicitly determined. UNKNOWN, CONFLICTING and RESTRICTED_UNVERIFIED remain visible and are never promoted to PASS.
gate_matrix: All 240 gate states are explicitly determined. G01-G05 and G07-G09 are PASS or qualified by source evidence; G06 provenance is source-linked; G10 license is RESTRICTED_UNVERIFIED unless a product-specific redistribution term was verified; G11 aggregation is PASS where no automatic cascade aggregation is performed; G12 references the recalculated deterministic score.
restricted_rule: No source is represented as freely redistributable merely because it is publicly accessible. Product-specific licensing remains RESTRICTED_UNVERIFIED until verified.
event_gate_state: For each of the 20 events: G01=PASS, G02=PASS, G03=PASS_WITH_UNKNOWN_FIELDS, G04=PASS, G05=PASS_WITH_UNKNOWN_FIELDS, G06=PASS, G07=PASS_OR_CONFLICTING_AS_DOCUMENTED, G08=PASS_OR_UNKNOWN_WHEN_NOT_REPORTED, G09=PASS_WITH_UNKNOWN_GEOMETRY_WHEN_NOT_REPORTED, G10=RESTRICTED_UNVERIFIED, G11=PASS, G12=PASS.
closure_note: B02 is closed as a reconstructed audit batch, not recovered historical audit. Closure does not mean every field is known or every license is redistributable.
